name: Women Preaching The Gospel
overview: Scripture reveals that women played an active role in proclaiming God's message, as seen in the outpouring of the Spirit at Pentecost where sons and daughters alike were called to prophesy. The example of Priscilla instructing Apollos more accurately in the way of God and the mention of four daughters who prophesied demonstrate women's participation in teaching and proclaiming the gospel. Additionally, commendations of women like Phebe, a servant of the church, and Junia, noted among the apostles, affirm their recognized involvement in the early church's ministry.
